The '''Rothana Imperial Shipyards''' were an [[orbit]]al [[shipyard]] over the [[planet]] [[Rothana]] operated by the [[Galactic Empire]]<ref name="PD9" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="Appendix" /> in the construction of [[warship]]s and various [[TIE series|TIE craft]]. It was abandoned by the Empire in [[5 ABY]] in preparation for the [[Battle of Jakku]], leaving several unfinished ships. However, a [[6 ABY|year later]], a group of criminals based on [[Kaddak]], including former base defense [[stormtrooper]] [[Terex]], plotted to steal the ships remaining there.<ref name="PD9" />
